concern_results.conclusion: Extraction reads only top-level error/*.failed events (message or error.message), the quota and auth greps now cover both $STDERR_FILE and the extracted events with the CLI's actual 'usage limit' wording added, and classifier order, reason codes, and cascade flags are unchanged, so event-stream-only quota classifies quota/true, credential rejection provider_unavailable/true, item-nested quota text stays unknown_client_failure/false, and stderr classification is preserved — all matching the stated acceptance.

The receipt diagnostic is built solely from transport-authored top-level events, raw stderr has no path into the committed receipt, and the builder redacts home/run-root paths, URL userinfo and query strings, sk-/Bearer/JWT shapes, and every assignment-shaped value before a 600-character single-line bound; the preserved run dir stays mode 0700 under TMPDIR; the one residue is the landed plan.md still prescribing the rejected stderr fallback, reported below.

Extraction and redaction both fail soft (unreadable or malformed events yield an empty transport-errors file, python errors are swallowed, and an empty builder result is replaced by a fixed non-empty fallback sentence), the diagnostic is emitted on every branch after a non-zero run including classified and timeout exits, and the signal-trap receipt without a diagnostic is an operator interrupt, not a transport failure.

Each protected predicate has an independently failable row: event-stream quota/auth classification, the item-nested veto with a unique leak marker, assignment-shape and quoted-value redaction with credential shapes assembled at runtime so repository scanners stay green, the 600-character bound, truncation, stderr exclusion, run-dir preservation and privacy, and absence of the new keys on success; the claimed red baseline and per-predicate mutations are consistent with what the diff's assertions actually bind.

emit_inconclusive only appends two optional positional arguments defaulting to empty, so every existing call site is behavior-identical; no flag, exit code, or existing reason code changes, and the heredocs are written to files outside command substitution with /bin/bash -n evidence for Bash 3.2.

The change is additive and local to one wrapper: reverting restores prior behavior with no migration, persisted state, or consumer contract to unwind, and the new receipt keys are relayed opaquely by review_gate.py while egress_schema.py governs only the opencode lane and is correctly untouched.

The evidence-destruction defect is repaired at its cause: a failed run preserves RUN_ROOT with both captured streams and the receipt names it in transport_run_dir, while transport_diagnostic records what the transport said about itself — including an explicit sentence when it said nothing — so a wrong classification can no longer stand unfalsified.

Reviewer-lane steering through packet-quoted quota vocabulary is contained by restricting classifier input to top-level transport events with a red fixture proving nested item text cannot classify, and the receipt-egress crossing is contained by removing arbitrary process output from the committed artifact rather than relying on the redactor, which remains only as defence in depth; CANDIDATE_LOCAL_CODES and all reason-code meanings are unchanged.
